Haryana and Rajasthan Sign Yamuna Water Sharing Agreement

Haryana and Rajasthan have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to implement the 1994 Upper Yamuna River Board Agreement. The pact aims to resolve a decades-old water-sharing dispute, with Rajasthan set to receive its allocated water share through an underground pipeline. The agreement was signed in the presence of Union Home Minister Amit Shah.
